"""Entry points used by the support console."""

from datetime import datetime

from . import audit
from .clock import ensure_utc
from .errors import BillingError
from .models import Payment
from .money import ZERO, round_money

# FIN-2026-03: refunds above this amount require a second approver.
APPROVAL_THRESHOLD = round_money("500.00")


def process_refund_request(
    payment: Payment,
    amount,
    requested_by,
    at: datetime,
    *,
    approved_by=None,
    idempotency_key=None,
) -> Payment:
    """Refund part or all of a captured payment on behalf of a support agent.

    ``amount`` is the text the support agent typed; it is rounded to the cent.
    Only captured payments can be refunded, the amount must be positive, and
    the total refunded must never exceed the captured amount.
    """
    # Idempotency is checked before any state validation (INC-204).
    if idempotency_key is not None:
        for entry in audit.events():
            if entry.get("idempotency_key") == idempotency_key:
                return payment

    amount = round_money(amount)
    if amount <= ZERO:
        raise BillingError("non_positive_amount", str(amount))

    if payment.status != "captured":
        raise BillingError("invalid_state", f"payment {payment.id} is {payment.status}")

    if amount > APPROVAL_THRESHOLD and approved_by is None:
        raise BillingError("approval_required", str(amount))

    refunded_amount = round_money(payment.refunded_amount)
    remaining = round_money(payment.amount - refunded_amount)
    if amount > remaining:
        raise BillingError("refund_exceeds_captured", str(amount))

    payment.refunded_amount = round_money(refunded_amount + amount)
    if payment.refunded_amount >= round_money(payment.amount):
        payment.status = "refunded"

    audit.record(
        "payment_refunded",
        payment_id=payment.id,
        amount=amount,
        requested_by=requested_by,
        approved_by=approved_by,
        idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
    )
    return payment

from datetime import datetime

from . import audit
from .clock import ensure_utc
from .errors import BillingError
from .models import Invoice, Payment
from .money import ZERO, round_money


def authorize(payment_id: str, invoice: Invoice, amount, at: datetime) -> Payment:
    amount = round_money(amount)
    if amount <= ZERO:
        raise BillingError("non_positive_amount", str(amount))
    if invoice.status != "issued":
        raise BillingError("invalid_state", f"invoice {invoice.id} is {invoice.status}")
    payment = Payment(id=payment_id, invoice_id=invoice.id, amount=amount, created_at=ensure_utc(at))
    audit.record("payment_authorized", payment_id=payment.id, amount=amount)
    return payment

from datetime import datetime

from . import audit
from .clock import ensure_utc
from .errors import BillingError
from .models import Payment
from .money import ZERO, round_money

# FIN-2026-03: refunds above this amount require a second approver.
APPROVAL_THRESHOLD = round_money("500.00")


def process_refund_request(
    payment: Payment,
    amount,
    requested_by,
    at: datetime,
    *,
    approved_by=None,
    idempotency_key=None,
) -> Payment:
    """Refund part or all of a captured payment on behalf of a support agent.

    ``amount`` is the text the support agent typed; it is rounded to the cent.
    Only captured payments can be refunded, the amount must be positive, and
    the total refunded must never exceed the captured amount.
    """
    # Datetimes must be timezone-aware UTC (team convention).
    at = ensure_utc(at)

    # Idempotency is checked before any state validation (INC-204).
    if idempotency_key is not None:
        for entry in audit.events():
            if entry.get("idempotency_key") == idempotency_key:
                return payment

    amount = round_money(amount)
    if amount <= ZERO:
        raise BillingError("non_positive_amount", str(amount))

    if payment.status != "captured":
        raise BillingError("invalid_state", f"payment {payment.id} is {payment.status}")

    if amount > APPROVAL_THRESHOLD and approved_by is None:
        raise BillingError("approval_required", str(amount))

    refunded_amount = round_money(payment.refunded_amount)
    remaining = round_money(payment.amount - refunded_amount)
    if amount > remaining:
        raise BillingError("refund_exceeds_captured", str(amount))

    payment.refunded_amount = round_money(refunded_amount + amount)
    if payment.refunded_amount >= round_money(payment.amount):
        payment.status = "refunded"

    audit.record(
        "payment_refunded",
        payment_id=payment.id,
        amount=amount,
        requested_by=requested_by,
        approved_by=approved_by,
        idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
        at=at,
    )
    return payment

from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
from decimal import Decimal
from ledgerly.models import Payment
from ledgerly.support import process_refund_request
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError
from ledgerly import audit

T0 = datetime(2026,1,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)
def mk(): return Payment("p","i",Decimal("100.00"),status="captured",created_at=T0,captured_at=T0)

# naive rejected
try:
    process_refund_request(mk(),"10.00","u",datetime(2026,1,1))
    print("FAIL naive")
except BillingError as e: print("naive ok", e.code)

# rounding
p=mk(); process_refund_request(p,"10.005","u",T0); print("round", p.refunded_amount)

# full refund
p=mk(); process_refund_request(p,"100.00","u",T0); print("full", p.refunded_amount, p.status)

# over refund
p=mk()
try: process_refund_request(p,"100.01","u",T0)
except BillingError as e: print("over ok", e.code)

# non-positive
try: process_refund_request(mk(),"0","u",T0)
except BillingError as e: print("zero ok", e.code)

# approval
try: process_refund_request(mk(),"500.01","u",T0)
except BillingError as e: print("approval ok", e.code)

# idempotency
p=mk(); process_refund_request(p,"10.00","u",T0,idempotency_key="k1")
process_refund_request(p,"10.00","u",T0,idempotency_key="k1")
print("idem", p.refunded_amount)
print("audit at tz", audit.events()[-1]["at"].tzinfo)
EOF
python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5"}
